responsibility: Contains the principal RTL machine description for Nios II instruction selection and scheduling. It defines hard-register constants, UNSPEC codes, instruction attributes and pipeline reservations, core move/arithmetic/compare/control/custom-instruction patterns, trap and PIC/TLS support patterns, and includes the target’s predicate, constraint, synchronization, and multiword-transfer descriptions, thereby mapping generic RTL operations into concrete Nios II assembly encodings and backend expanders.
same_name_distinction: Unlike nios2.cc, which provides C++ hook implementations, and nios2.h/.opt, which define macros and options, this machine-description file is the RTL pattern layer for Nios II: it names hard registers and UNSPECs and maps generic operations to concrete instruction, attribute, and scheduling patterns.
